problem_title: Find First Occurrence of Pattern in Text (KMP Prefix Table)
input_contract: Given a text string and a pattern string, return the index of the first occurrence of pattern in text, or -1 if not found. Empty pattern returns 0.

variants.name: Naive String Matching
variants.strategy: Sliding window: try every start position and compare character by character until mismatch or full match.

pseudocode: For each possible start position i, compare substring text[i…] with pattern
On mismatch, immediately break and move to next i
If the whole substring matches, return i

variants.name: KMP Algorithm
variants.strategy: Compute a prefix table (pi) that stores the longest proper prefix suffix lengths, then use it to skip ahead on mismatches instead of restarting from scratch.

pseudocode: Compute prefix table pi: longest proper prefix which is also suffix
Scan text with pattern pointer j; on mismatch backtrack using pi
If j reaches m, pattern found
